formula: peak_mib = a*vsum^2 + b*vsum + c   (vsum in M-voxels)
vsum_definition: resampled FULL-volume (pre-crop upper bound) voxel count of the lowres + fullres configs (cascading config excluded: same space as fullres, runs after lowres; the fitted peak absorbs the small fullres/cascade overlap)

validation.expected: REJECT (the study OOMed the A100 in the OOM probe; 40,381/40,960 MiB)

provenance: Measured on a 40,960 MiB A100: startup floor B0=5095 MiB; per-study measured floors 9857/13159/26751 MiB for study-1/2/3; study-4 OOM probe: RMM pool extension refused at 40,381/40,960 MiB (2026-09-10). Payloads are synthetic volumes sized to each study's resampled full+lowres voxel count.
recompute_when: weights or pipeline change, or a new corpus study is measured that deviates from the model by > 25%
